name: Yakumo Nene
source:
The self-proclaimed Goddess of Yuri, Academy's problem child, and the first ever in school's history to repeat a grade. She was once enrolled in the Advanced Course, but is now stuck repeating the first year in the Standard Course. 17 years old.

She's roommates with the petite, yet pompous Rebis, as well as her beloved Nanna. Despite being a shut-in, people have seen her walking around the school at night.

An unsociable and gloomy individual, Nene suffers from mental health problems. Thinking she had a shot, she once confessed to a classmate and got rejected. She has yet to recover.

All the same, last year she received the blessing of Sagittarius, becoming an [i]Angel[/i] of the Zodiac. 

This gave her the ability to hack into the minds of others -- or rather, into the implants they were given when they entered the Academy. With this power, she could've easily put an end to the Principal's plans at any point of her choosing.

The thing is, Nene doesn't care about that. At all.

She uses her powers to summon imaginary angels, commanding them to seek out girls who look like they'd be into each other and play cupid with them. This is what she lives for.

Cup noodles in hand, she strolls through the school's corridors in the dead of night.

[Based on [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1982006465201365175]two[/url] separate [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1991781640096608351]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
